sources.skip_reason: GitLab's own Search API docs state verbatim "Every call to this API requires authentication." (https://docs.gitlab.com/api/search/), and a live probe of GET https://gitlab.com/api/v4/search?scope=blobs&search=test returned HTTP 401. The code-search scope therefore cannot be used without a token, and no token flow is implemented.

PublicWWW's own API authentication docs state verbatim "A paid plan is required: without one, every endpoint except / and /v1/account answers 403 plan_required." (https://publicwww.com/docs/api/authentication/). A paid-only source is barred by standing rule 4, so it is not implemented. (Its documented base URL is https://api.publicwww.com with an Authorization: Bearer header, recorded for context only.)
